posts.author: Deleted member 271924
posts.body:
i will copypaste the info i placed on r/tipofmyjoystick, i hope someone that sees this can remember me because I HAVE SUCH A BAD MEMORY, its like, giving me a headache from trying to remember that game.​
[PC] [2015-2020] rpg-maker-looking game with a gladiator mc​
Platform(s): computer, i think its only for pc
Genre:2d, rpg, turn based combat, fantasy, possibly rpg-maker
Estimated year of release: im pretty sure it isnt older than 2015, last time i played was around 2021/2022 tho, so it may be recent
Graphics/art style:2d rpg-maker looking scenario, but its well made, the characters dont look like the normal assets tho, character icons are hand drawn.
Notable characters:you can choose which story to start on a world map, the only one i played was the one that you start as a gladiator!, youre a old/lanky looking gladiator that gets the chance to escape the arena and ends up drowning on a river, where youre rescued by farmers, after that you get a female elf archer ally and a human boy with metal armor in your team.
Notable gameplay mechanics:the game has in-map enemies that walk around, and when they find you, go after you to start turn based battle, with a time-line turn based mechanic, with each character having their own icon on a ''conveyor belt'' dictating who goes first, besides that, you can unlock skills with points earned after each battle, you can also use a fishing rod to fish, and axes to cut wood and gather plants from nature and even get pickaxes to mine ores for crafting, and do several quests related to that, also mentioned earlier, you can choose which character you start with, with each one having a different story, i dont remember the other 2 characters, but the one i chose was the recommended one, which was the previously mentioned, old gladiator.
Other details: already entered in all the details that i remember from the game, no idea of any of the words on the name to give as a basis, and all i can say from my experience, is that the game starts as a fugitive gladiator, then you get kinda on a ''choose what to do'' scenario, and you can do quests and progress in the maps, and i finished playing for the last time when i entered a cave full of big spiders and mining carts, as a quest from the farmer that saves you. and again, this game is heavily rpg-maker looking, not 100%, but like, it seems that i was made using some assets, or a similar game-maker tool, also, the gladiator thing is just the backstory of the character, you stop being a gladiator in the first 20 minutes of gameplay, so it isnt a ''gladiator game'' just a gladiator character in a fantasy rpg game
